Ryan Garcia defeats Conor Benn by TKO in welterweight title defense

Ryan Garcia successfully defended his WBC welterweight title by defeating Conor Benn via a second-round technical knockout (TKO) in Las Vegas. Garcia's victory was decisive, with Benn being outclassed and ultimately stopped by the champion. Following the fight, Benn was taken to the hospital. Benn later broke his silence about the defeat, and Chris Eubank Jr. made a public comment about Benn's performance.
